data.therapeutic_indication: Vaccine against feline viral rhinotracheitis, feline calicivirosis, feline panleucopenia and feline leukaemia. Stimulates active immunity against feline rhinotracheitis virus, feline calicivirus, feline panleucopenia virus and feline leukaemia virus. The feline leukaemia vaccine strain is a recombinant canarypox virus expressing the env and gag genes of FeLV-A. Under field conditions, only sub-group A is infective and immunisation against subgroup A provides full protection against A, B and C. After inoculation, the virus expresses the protective proteins, but does not replicate in the cat. As a consequence, the vaccine induces an immune status against feline leukaemia virus.

Tyruko is indicated as single disease modifying therapy in adults with highly active relapsing remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) for the following patient groups: Patients with highly active disease despite a full and adequate course of treatment with at least one disease modifying therapy (DMT) (for exceptions and information about washout periods see sections 4.4 and 5.1) or Patients with rapidly evolving severe RRMS defined by 2 or more disabling relapses in one year, and with 1 or more Gadolinium enhancing lesions on brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) or a significant increase in T2 lesion load as compared to a previous recent MRI.
